name: did-we-drift
description: Project-drift audit for agent-built software: verifies a durable, version-controlled plan/tracking surface exists (root authority, evidence-gated progress, drift definition, audit cadence, dated baseline), then verdicts ON TRACK / DRIFTED (MINOR|MATERIAL|CAPTURED) / BLOCKED / NO BASELINE with the smallest course correction. QUICK single-agent audit by default; contamination-scaled DEEP fan-out with a plan-blind work lane when triggers fire. Run at the end of every gate, phase, or wave.
